[b]This maintenance update may take several hours.[/b]
[b]This update involves extensive changes to the underlying systems, which may cause some issues. I will continue to release frequent updates and fixes over the next two weeks. If you encounter any issues, please join Discord for feedback and discussion.[/b]

[olist][*]Weapons now support embedding 【Crystallizers】, which can be used to customize bullet appearance, trajectories, number of bullets, special effects, etc.[/*][*]All equipment now has an evolution system; all gear can be upgraded to ST quality.[/*][*]Added Set Specialization feature, allowing players to unlock multiple set attributes and effects for selection.[/*][*]Added Divine Manifestation Codex, enabling cross-class sharing of set passive effects.[/*][/olist]
Impact of this update:
[olist][*]To support equipment evolution, additional attributes on ST rings have been uniformly adjusted to HP and maximum HP.[/*][*]Some equipment (no longer dropped by monsters) has been removed, and their ST versions no longer support set effects.[/*][/olist]

A new NPC named 【Santa Claus】 has been added in the main city to provide the following functions:[/*][*]1. Use current ST gear that has lost its set effect to 【select freely】 a new ST gear with a different set. Affixes and elemental enchantments will be transferred accordingly.[/*][*]2. Players can now transfer affixes and elemental enchantments between owned ST gears, with a limit of 5 transfers per account.[/*][/list]
[b]Fixes[/b]
[list][*]Fixed the issue where item names displayed as乱码 in private chat messages.[/*][*]Fixed the issue where Oscar's melee attacks were ineffective.[/*][*]Fixed the issue where the F3 hidden interface could not be restored after character death.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Statement on Values Balancing and Feedback
notes.content:
Dear Players,

The values adjustments in this update may have affected the performance of certain classes or heroes. Please note that these adjustments are not in their final version. If you encounter any issues or have suggestions for improvement, please leave a message or join our Discord "Feedback" channel to let me know. I will actively make adjustments based on your feedback to ensure balance among all classes and heroes.

Your input is invaluable to me and helps me continuously improve the game. Going forward, I will handle numerical adjustments with greater caution to provide a better gaming experience.

Thank you for your understanding and support. Let’s work together to create a fairer and more enjoyable gaming environment!

Happy gaming,
CUNX

notes.title: Sincere Apology and Compensation for the Recent Update
notes.content:
Dear Players,

Over the past two weeks, I have made adjustments to the game mechanics and balance, which may have resulted in a less enjoyable experience for some players and raised concerns about the future of the game. For this, I sincerely apologize and thank you all for your patience and support.

To increase transparency and prevent similar issues from happening again, I have opened an "Update Preview" channel on Discord. Here, I will share my development progress and future plans weekly. Everyone is welcome to follow and engage with me there.

Moving forward, I will focus on introducing new heroes, bosses, maps, and innovative gameplay elements, aiming to enrich and enhance the game experience.

Thank you once again to every player who has supported me. Let’s look forward to an even better gaming experience together!

The related compensation has been sent to your in-game mailbox. Please check your mailbox to claim the following items: 1500 gold coins, 3000 merit points, 5 enhancement scrolls, and 5 talent potions.

Best regards,
CUNX

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Removed talent level settings and restrictions.
[*] Remove the setting of skill points.
[*] Professional skills are merged into the skill, talent and specialization column.
[*] Adjust talent categories:
[*] Skill Specialization (15-18) – Skill-related enhancements and passive skills
[*] Level cap (5) – Unlock the character level cap
